content: {"praised":["Unique monster created in-house by Universal writers","Old black‑and‑white mummy films are fun and enjoyable","Great original and spin‑offs with deep background","Excellent collection for a Saturday night film fest","Good for adding classic Boris Karloff titles to a collection"],"criticized":["Later films feel like a waste of the first movie’s success","Summer mummy movies overuse CGI and lose charm","Stories after the first three degenerate into repetition","Some films are not worth watching beyond the first one","The series lacks fresh storytelling after the initial entries"]}
